issues.finding: Starts with multiply-reciprocal rule, without connecting division to equal-size groups. Source explanation says 分子分母同乘後約分, which confuses multiplying fractions with forming an equivalent fraction.
issues.replacement: First show3/4÷1/8:6/8 contains six1/8 groups. Generalise same-denominator (ae)/(be) ÷ (bc)/(be)=ae/bc, hence multiply e/c. Replace ambiguous wording with 分子相乘、分母相乘，最後約分.
issues.resolution: Implemented tightly scoped stepsFor fractionDivide and5N5 same-whole common-denominator SVG in course_pedagogy.js.

issues.finding: Every active question asks alignment/setup facts. A turntable changes angle but does not practise selecting inner vs outer protractor scale.
issues.replacement: Add a diagram with visible0-start and both scales; ask a concrete reading, e.g.60° vs120°. Keep old IDs as historical; add new template ID, teach it before testing. Retain explicit turntable limitation.

issues.finding: Tool mission2x+3=11 requires two steps; active chapter practices onlyx+a=b.
issues.replacement: For exact one-step alignment change tool config to{a:1,b:3,c:11} and adjust mission text; alternatively visibly label two-step extension and keep it outside one-step mastery. Classroom pack currently describes actual existing button sequence.
issues.resolution: Parent aligning config to a1,b3,c11; pack task updated to x=8.

issues.finding: Fixed triangle coordinates depict base405px,height156px for every generated base and height. The changing length labels therefore do not share a scale.
issues.replacement: Choose f=min(maxWidth/base,maxHeight/height), plot base*f and height*f with perpendicular foot; retain right-angle mark. Do not use a fixed picture with changing dimension labels.

issues.finding: Generated diagrams use17–23px SVG labels. This conflicts with independent child reading target24px+. Narrow small subunits can become unreadable on mobile.
issues.replacement: Use24px+ labels and larger viewBox/vertical stacking for two jugs. For fraction units show grouped bars with a legible count, preserving equal partitions.

issues.finding: Procedural multiply-numerators/denominators steps do not explain why number of equal parts multiplies.
issues.replacement: Use2×3 equal grid, select1/2 then1/3 of selected half:1 of6 equal parts. Link denominator product to total equal cells.

issues.replacement: Keep chapter-scope notice. Broaden by new explained and practised templates in a later explicit content expansion; never claim official unit completion from the present scores.

issues.finding: Instructions rely on external objects to touch/rotate/count. No linked tool exists for mapOnly5S2.
